verdict.rationale: Zep documents per-user Context Graphs (private memory) plus attribute-based access control governing 'UserGroups' and policies that limit what context each agent or Memory MCP user can reach, implying group-level sharing with least-privilege control (zep-docs-12, zep-docs-25, zep-docs-31, zep-docs-38, zep-docs-42). However, there is no concrete walkthrough or example showing how a team/group memory graph is created, shared across multiple agents/users, or how privacy boundaries are enforced in practice. Missing for 10: a documented example of creating/using a shared UserGroup graph, explicit demonstration of selective sharing vs. private isolation, and independent/hands-on confirmation that group memory works as described.
